# EventSetupSG

> EventSetupSG is a full-service event setup and logistics company in Singapore. Services: booth setup for roadshows and exhibitions, LED screen and display rental, island-wide event logistics and transport, teardown, and warehousing in a 600-pallet warehouse. One team, 24-hour island-wide deployment, same-day itemised quotes, no subcontracting.

## Services

- [Booth Setup Singapore](https://www.eventsetupsg.com/booth-setup-singapore): end-to-end booth setup for roadshows, exhibitions and brand activations, including fabrication coordination, on-site assembly, styling and full teardown.
- [LED Screen Rental Singapore](https://www.eventsetupsg.com/led-screen-rental-singapore): portable LED bars, illuminated counters and display panels, delivered, installed and configured.
- [Event Logistics Singapore](https://www.eventsetupsg.com/event-logistics-singapore): island-wide transport with vans, lorries and trucks, plus 600-pallet warehousing and storage.

## Recent work

- Event footage from AIA HYROX Singapore (LED wall, branded podium, media wall, selfie corner) is shown on the homepage as an example of the kind of booth setup EventSetupSG builds, with an F45 Community photo banner from the same event.
- Recent jobs on the homepage: Tiger Balm × The Kiprun Singapore recovery tent and tent wall; Redoxon mall roadshow curved LED counter (video and photos) and Redoxon LED totem; Glenlivet LED counter at a night activation outside Jade Phoenix (video) and Glenlivet banquet LED pillars; curved LED counter inside a Unity pharmacy store (video).
